title: DSG PLayIT v2.2.1
changelog:
- Permanent Time & Battery HUD: persistent top-right video player overlay with live clock and battery percentage
- Distraction-free HUD design: removed AM/PM and time icon for a compact, minimal look with subtle translucent scrim
- Quick Action 'Time' toggle: one-tap pill button in player controls with active highlight
- Playback preferences persistence: time overlay setting saved across sessions
- Improved title marquee spacing and dynamic HUD repositioning to prevent overlap
